records.DESCRIPTION:
ABS Outstanding : As reported, during the main engine test at Shanghai port after main engine overhauled, damage to the main engine flywheel and turning gear was discovered. According to the investigation by the vessel crew and the main engine maker technician, following damage was observed:
- Main engine turning gear sensor failure, the turning gear motor casing cracked, and varying degree damage to the turning gear shaft and bearings.
- Eleven (11) teeth of the main engine flywheel ring gear located from TDC Cyl.9 around 185 degree to TDC Cyl.2 around 145 degree found destroyed and detached. The total number of the teeth of the main engine flywheel ring gear is one hundred and thirty-five (135).
- Main engine RCS safety system and main engine RCS control system abnormal, the cylinder Crank Angle signal not available and main engine failed to start.
Above affected damage was repaired by the main engine maker technician and reported as below,
1. The main engine turning gear was replaced entirely with new spare parts at this time, including the motor, shaft, bearings and gear etc.  The newly installed turning gear was provided by the main engine maker, and particulars were verified and found to match the original. Details are as below:
Manufacturer: CSSC Chongqing Qingping Machinery Co., Ltd.          Type: X92          Serial No.: 260011
Power: 15KW          Voltage/Period: 440V/60Hz          Speed: 0.976r/Min          Torque Normal: 137KN.m
Torque Maximum: 197KN.m          Grease: VG320          Date: 2026/06      
2. Following the main engine turning gear replacement, teeth contact area between main engine flywheel and turning gear was verified by ink test and considered satisfactory. Main engine flywheel zero point was inspected and adjusted by the maker technician in present of the attending surveyor and found in order.
3. The operation test for the main engine turning gear was carried out in present of the attending surveyor and found satisfactory, excluding the main engine flywheel cannot make one full rotation through the turning gear due to the damaged main engine flywheel ring gear detached.
4. Speed sensors (totally 7pcs: 3pcs for main engine, 4pcs for remote control system) were verified, adjusted by the maker technician and found satisfactory. Cylinder crank angel signal for each main engine cylinder was inspected/realigned by the technician in working condition. Main engine RCS safety system and main engine RCS control system were reset and found in order. 
5. Main engine crankcase including main bearing and thrust bearing was inspected by the vessel crew and found in order.
Upon completion of above repair/verification, the main engine commissioning test was carried out at the anchorage in present of the attending surveyor and found satisfactory, excluding the main engine speed signal (RPM reading) is unstable (periodic fluctuation) on the bridge ME RPM Indicator and BDP Unit due to the existence of the damaged main engine flywheel ring gear. The main engine speed signal (RPM reading) is normal on the bridge both AMS Workstation Indicators and ICMS Data Computer Monitor.
The main engine control model at Engine Side, Engine Control Room and Bridge was tested and found in order. The vessel owner is keeping the main engine control with MANNED in engine control room currently due to the main engine speed signal (RPM reading) unstable (periodic fluctuation) on the bridge partial monitor/indicator. The risk assessments provided by the vessel Master was verified and considered satisfactory. The vessel Minimum Safe Manning Document and IMO Crew List were reviewed and found satisfactory. 
The vessel's ACCU Control and Monitoring System was affected at this time as result of the main engine flywheel and turning gear repair, the required displays, alarms, and safety features of the onboard Main Engine could not be properly shown at the remote center control station as per ABS Rule 2026 MVR 4-9-6/5, MVR 4-9-2/13 and MVR 4-9-2/Table 2. The same was reported in finding No.45 in the same work order.
As reported by the vessel owner, the damaged main engine flywheel ring gear spare parts were not available at this time. The period of repairs will be around two months, and the same was confirmed by the main engine maker. The vessel owner is requesting two months’ exemption to allow the spare parts to be delivered onboard and complete the repair. As authorized by EH GC ACS survey department, Condition of Class was raised, valid until 17 September 2026.

ABS Outstanding : With reference to finding No.44 in the same work order, as result of the main engine flywheel and turning gear repair, the required displays, alarms, and safety features of the onboard Main Engine could not be properly shown at the remote center control station as per ABS Rule 2026 MVR 4-9-6/5, MVR 4-9-2/13 and MVR 4-9-2/Table 2.
